title: constant name inconsistency
symptom: The SlopeParameters constant "DEFAUL_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW" should be "DEFAULT_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW" in Calibration.java. The missing 'T' is an inconsistency in naming.
cause: The constant name has a typo: 'DEFAUL_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW' instead of 'DEFAULT_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW'.
fix: The issue was resolved in commit 6d170f24913eae811ff0074a98a0e7cbb7355c17, which fixed the constant name.
evidence_quote: This should now be resolved in commit: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/6d170f24913eae811ff0074a98a0e7cbb7355c17
